title: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a moment-of-inertia factor of 0.3308
summary: The fact sheet lists I/MR² as 0.3308.
body: NASA's Earth Fact Sheet lists a moment-of-inertia factor, I/MR², of 0.3308. The card records that entry. It does not interpret the number as a proof of how mass is arranged inside Earth.

sources.title: Earth Fact Sheet
sources.author: David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
sources.note: Last Updated line on the page: 15 November 2024, DRW.
